I can't tell you what Northgate holds in Hotel. "Northgate" isn't a holder in this Harbor State session, and I can't share another client's positions. If Northgate is another client, their information is outside this mandate. If you meant something else, tell me and I'll look.

Harbor State's own exposure to FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING is $18.0M market value, per the mandate profile.

The BDC's public schedule is in filing 0009000012-26-000121. It lists 8 first-lien term loans, with fair values in USD:

| Row | Borrower | Fair value | Principal | PIK |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 101 | Brightwater Fitness Holdings LLC | 17,765,000 | 19,000,000 | none |
| 102 | Redwood Valley Foods Inc. | 10,285,000 | 11,000,000 | none |
| 103 | Clearpath Billing Solutions LLC | 8,901,000 | 9,000,000 | none |
| 104 | Oakmont Home Services LLC | 8,971,380 | 9,108,000 | 3% |
| 105 | Pinecrest Learning Group Inc. | 15,840,000 | 16,000,000 | none |
| 106 | Seabright Marine Supply Co. | 19,480,000 | 20,000,000 | none |
| 107 | Tidewater Environmental LLC | 16,881,000 | 17,000,000 | none |

I only pulled the current schedule, so I haven't compared it with the prior period. I can't say whether the 3% PIK on Oakmont (row 104) is new or increased. I'd need the prior schedule for that.
